title: Canonical bar union augmentation
statement: Let Y be a scheme, A its category of module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], L_n a cochain tower with transitions l_n, and D a stage-filtered diagram with specified stage colimits L_n and all the finite compact-flat piece properties of [lem-sc-compact-flat-finite-subcomplex-diagrams]. Let T be a flat telescope [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map] and p_n:L_n→T satisfy l_n;p_(n+1)=p_n. There exist towers R_n,F_n with transitions s_n,u_n and maps c_n:R_n→L_n, a_n:R_n→F_n. Every R_n and F_n is bounded above and termwise flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Every c_n is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Strictly, s_n;c_(n+1)=c_n;l_n and s_n;a_(n+1)=a_n;u_n. Every u_n is degreewise split monic. There are maps q_n:F_n→T with u_n;q_(n+1)=q_n and a_n;q_n=c_n;p_n. Put delta=identity minus shift on the coproduct of F_n, as in [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map]. For every proof that delta;desc(q)=0, the induced canonical map cokernel(delta)→T is an isomorphism in the homotopy category. This conclusion contains no splitting of the cokernel short complex.

proof.text: Extract the supplied literal telescope presentation of T and substitute its equality. Construct R_n as the explicit bar of the supplied source-stage diagram. Its upper bound, flatness and strict augmentation squares are proved by the three displayed source-bar property lemmas. Use sourceBarAugmentation_quasiIso for the proved principal-lower-ideal contraction and exact filtered-colimit argument; it supplies no object data.

Construct the finite cone blocks by finite coproducts and mappingCone.map. Factor every source piece through a block using its finite degree support and compact generator terms; the proved termwise monicity makes the resulting factor a chain map. The least factorization index defines the enlarged preorder and its actual diagram. Construct F_n as the bar on source labels and target indices at most n. The proved finite-block and bar-total properties give bounds and flatness. The bar reindexing API gives degreewise split transition maps, strict source-to-enlarged squares, strict enlarged augmentation squares and a_n;q_n=c_n;p_n. No resolution, factorization, splitting or diagram object is chosen from an unproved existence theorem.

Prove directly that the full enlarged bar is the colimit of its stages: a finite string has a maximum stage label, and its map under a compatible cocone is independent of later stages. Prove independently that the cokernel of identity minus shift is the sequential colimit. The resulting canonical isomorphism carries the full-bar augmentation exactly to cokernel.desc for every zero-relation proof. The target-chain inclusion and least-block retraction are actual bar maps with a proved strict section. The proved targetComparison gives their other inverse up to homotopy and invertibility of the target-chain augmentation. Cancel the target inclusion in the homotopy category, then compose with the proved canonical cokernel-to-full-bar isomorphism. This gives cokernelAugmentation_isIso and the last conjunct of the original statement. Assemble all six actual tower families and their proved properties in Lean.

proof_origin.place: The complete proof from explicit bars, finite cone blocks, principal-lower-ideal and partial-sum contractions, the signed total-cone comparison, and the two colimit universal properties. No new sorry remains.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_compact_flat_bar_union_augmentation (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (L : ℕ → CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (l : ∀ n : ℕ, L n ⟶ L (n + 1))
    (D : CompactFlatFiniteSubcomplexDiagrams Y L l)
    (T : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hT : isFlatTelescope Y T) (p : ∀ n : ℕ, L n ⟶ T)
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, l n ≫ p (n + 1) = p n) :
    let A := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
    let Q := HomotopyCategory.quotient A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    ∃ (R F : ℕ → CochainComplex A ℤ)
      (s : ∀ n : ℕ, R n ⟶ R (n + 1))
      (u : ∀ n : ℕ, F n ⟶ F (n + 1))
      (c : ∀ n : ℕ, R n ⟶ L n) (a : ∀ n : ℕ, R n ⟶ F n),
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ z : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, z < i → IsZero ((R n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((R n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ z : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, z < i → IsZero ((F n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((F n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, QuasiIso (c n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, s n ≫ c (n + 1) = c n ≫ l n) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, s n ≫ a (n + 1) = a n ≫ u n) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), IsSplitMono ((u n).f i)) ∧
      ∃ q : ∀ n : ℕ, F n ⟶ T,
        (∀ n : ℕ, u n ≫ q (n + 1) = q n) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, a n ≫ q n = c n ≫ p n) ∧
        ∀ hzero : flatTelescopeDifferential F u ≫ Sigma.desc q = 0,
          IsIso (Q.map
            (cokernel.desc (flatTelescopeDifferential F u) (Sigma.desc q) hzero))
